title: OZONOXY 100 Max
pageTitle: OZONOXY 100 Max — high-output ozone generator, 100 g/h
pageDescription: Ozone generator OZONOXY 100 Max. Output 100 g/h, rooms up to 1050 m³. Maximum coverage in a compact enclosure.
shortDesc: High-output ozone generator with 100 g/h output. Treatable room volume up to 1050 m³.
description: OZONOXY 100 Max offers the largest coverage in the 100 g/h range. It treats rooms up to 1050 m³, combining high output with a compact form factor. Intended for large production, warehouse, and industrial sites that need regular disinfection of extensive areas.
features: No nitrogen oxide generation during ozone production
Largest coverage area in the 100 g/h lineup
Oxygen feed via quick-connect fitting for up to 50% higher output
Metal enclosure with two-stage coating (zinc primer + cured enamel)
Fine filtration — prevents electrode degradation from dust and grease buildup
Multimodal operation — distribute ozone flows across rooms or zones at different times, power levels, and exposure
tasks: disinfection, pest control, rodent control, deodorization, detoxification
ctaText: Contact us for consultation and to place an order.
